title: Conveyance of Citycon Oyj's own shares for payment of rewards earned under incentive programme
text:
Conveyance of Citycon Oyj's own shares for payment of rewards earned under incentive programme Posted , 2018-01-10 Email this page Citycon Oyj has on 10 January 2018 conveyed 30,000 own shares held by the company in a directed share issue without consideration to two persons belonging to the key personnel of the company for payment of rewards earned under the Restricted Share Plan 2015 in accordance with the terms and conditions of said plan.
